verdict.rationale: Datadog documents autonomous background systems like Watchdog (automated anomaly detection), Monitors (automated alerting/actions), and Kubernetes Autoscaling, plus a Bits AI product page suggesting agentic AI capability, but there is no detailed evidence of a user-configurable AI-agent automation framework that runs multi-step autonomous tasks in the background. missing for 10: concrete documentation of Bits AI or Workflow Automation running autonomous, multi-step agent tasks without human intervention, and independent/hands-on confirmation of such agentic automations.
